data: Which of the following methods are analyzed in this figure?

The figure contains three graphs showing the performance of different methods on the training and validation sets. The methods being analyzed are:

1. SGD (red line)
2. NG (black line)
3. HF (blue line)
4. DSAG-HF (purple line)

These methods are compared across two datasets: the training set and the development set (dev.sub). Additionally, the lower graph shows the Word Error Rate (WER) with MPE LM as training progresses for these methods.
